simple.meaning: to grave , by implication, to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כָּתַב (H3789) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 227 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: כָּתַב (kâthab) means to grave , by implication, to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 41.

definitions.full: H3789. kathab כָּתַב 223 verb write (Late Hebrew id. ; Phoenician כתב ; Aramaic כְּתַב , Nabataean כתב , see especially Nö in Eut Nab. p. 43 ; thence Arabic Ethiopic book , Di Lex. 852 (as loan-words, Frä 249 DHM VOJ i (1887), 29 ); MV Buhl compare Arabic draw or sew together, conjoin (letters), etc., compare Fl ZMG 1873, 427 ) — Qal Perfect ׳כ Josh 8:32 +, כָּתַבְתָּ Jer 36:6 +, suffix וּכְתַבְתָּם consecutive Deut 6:9 ; 11:20 , etc. (Perfect 27 t.); Imperfect יִכְתֹּב Isa 44:5 , וַיִּכְתֹּב Exod 24:4 +, etc. (Imperfect 39 t.); Imperative כְּתֹב Isa 8:1 5 t., כְּתָבֿ Exod 34:27 2 t.; suffix כָּתְבָהּ Isa 30:8 , כָּתְבֵם Prov 3:3 ; 7:3 ; plural כִּתְבוּ Deut 31:9 3 t .; Infinitive absolute כָּתוֺכ Jer 32:44 ; cstr כְּתוֺב Psalm 87:8, לִכְתֹּב Deut 31:24 ; Josh 18:8 ; suffix כָּתְבוֺ Jer 45:1 ; Participle active כֹּתֵב 36:18 , plural כֹּתְבִים 32:12 ; Neh 10:1 ; passive (113 t.), כָּתוּב Josh 1:8 +, feminine כְּתוּבָה 2Sam 1:18 +, plural כְּתוּבִים 1Kin 15:7 +, כְּתֻבִים 11:41 +; feminine plural כְּתוּבוֺת 2Chr 34:24 ; — 1 write: a. with accusative, words Exod 34:27 , commandments 24:12 , etc.; accusative of congnate meaning with verb מכתב 39:30 , compare כַּמִּכְתָּב Deut 10:4 ; with כְּ , giving purport of writing, also Est 8:8 ; but object also a book, סֵפֶר Exod 32:32 ; Deut 24:1 ; מְגִלָּה Jer 38:6 , compare participle pass, וְאָחוֺר מָּנִים כְּתוּבָה וְהִיא Ezek 2:10 ( of מגלה ; i.e. written on both sides); a letter, סֵפָר 2Sam 11:14 ; 2Kin 10:1 4 t., אִגֶּרֶת 2Chr 30:1 ; a divorce-certificate כְּרִיתֻת סֵפֶר Deut 24:1 , etc.; even כְּתֻבִים לֻחֹת tablets inscribed by the finger of God Exod 31:18 compare Deut 9:10 ; ׳ל ׳כ עֶבְרֵיהֶם מִשְּׁנֵי Exod 32:15 tables inscribed on both sides (compare Ezek 2:10 above) Here belongs (probably) לי יָדוֺ יִכְתֹּב ׳וְזֶה Isa 44:5 and this one shall inscribe his hand, 'Yahweh's' , so ᵐ5 Hi Kn Che Br Du Di, Ges Ew De, shall sign (with) his hand unto ׳י . b. more often write something on , or in ( עַלֿ 85t., בְ 44t., אֶלֿ 3t.) a tablet, roll, book, etc. (object various, as above): — (I) ׳כ עַלֿ followed by סֵפֶר = book Deut 17:18 55t., especially in phrase וגו דברי עלסֿפר ׳כתובים 1Kin 11:41 + often Kings Chronicles; ׳כ עַלמְֿגִּלָּה Jer 36:2 ; 36:28 ; 36:32 ; Jeremiah 38:29; ׳כ עַללֿוּח(ותׅ Exod 34:1 7 t., עַלאֶֿבֶן Deut 27:3 2 t., עַלגּֿלָּיוֺן Isa 8:1 ; בַּיִת עַלמְֿזֻזוֺת Deut 6:9 ; 11:20 ; עַלמַֿטֶּה on a rod Numbers 17:17; Numbers 17:18; עַלעֵֿץ Ezek 37:16 (twice in verse), עַלצִֿיץ (high priest's plate) Exod 39:30 ; even (only Chronicles) עַלֿ followed by name of book or its contents: — ׳כ נָתָן עַלדִּֿבְרֵי 2Chr 9:29 ; compare 33:19 ; וגו ׳עַלמִֿדְרַשׁ 24:27 ; עַלהַֿקִּינוֺת 35:25 ; figurative, ׳כ עַללִֿבָּם Jeremiah 31:83 I will write them upon their heart ; compare ׳כ לִבֶּ֑ךָ עַללֿוּחַ Prov 3:3 . (2) ׳כ אֶלֿ appears for ׳כ עַלֿ only Jer 36:2 compare Ezek 2:10 ; Jer 51:60 . (3) ׳כ בְּ followed by ספר = book Josh 24:26 (E) + 35 t.; = letter, bill, deed , 1Kin 21:9 5 t.; עָלָ֑י כָּתוּב סֵפֶר בִּמְגִלַּת Psa 40:8 it is prescribed to me , על as 2Kin 22:13 (N.B. ׳כ עלֿ not used with סֵפֶר = letter , and ׳כ בְּ not used with אבן לוּחַ, or עֵץ ). c. other uses of perp. with ׳כ are: — בְּ instrumental, ׳כ אֱנוֺשׁ בְּחֶרֶט Isa 8:1 , ׳כ בַּרְזֶל בְּעֵט Jer 17:1 ; אֱלֹהִים בְּאֶצְבַּע כְּתֻבִים Deut 9:10 ; Exod 31:18 ; ׳כ אֶלֿ unto , of person to whom letter, etc., is addressed 2Sam 11:14 ; 2Kin 10:6 ; Est 9:13 ; עַלֿ substantive for אֶלֿ (late) 2Chr 30:1 ; Ezra 4:7 ; Est 8:8 ; the fuller construction is ׳כ (אֶלֿׅ וישׁלח ספר 2Kin 10:1 ; Est 8:10 ; 9:20 +; ׳כ אֶלֿ write down for the benefit or use of some one, Judg 8:14 ; לְ to or for , Deut 17:18 ; 24:1 +; note especially תּוֺרָתִי רֻבֵּו֯ אֶכְתָּו֯בלֿוֺ Hosea 8:12 , i.e. either, I write (keep writing) for them ever so many (We, רֹב , compare Ew and most רִבּוֺ(אׅ a myriad) of my directions , or 'Though I write,' 'Were I to write,' etc.; ׳כ followed by ל with infinitive of purpose 2Chr 32:17 ; Est 8:5 ; with מִן in phrase ׳כ פ ׳מִמִּי write from the mouth of any one i.e. from dictation, Jer 36:2 , 32 ; 38:6 , 17 , 27 ; 45:1 . 2 = write down describe in writing , ׳כ אֶתהָֿאָרֶץ Judg 18:4 , 6 , 8 (3 t. in verse); 18:9 . 3 = register enroll Isa 10:19 (= record the number), 1Chr 24:6 ; especially passive הַכְּתוּבִים Num 11:26 those enrolled compare Neh 12:22 ; ׳הַכּ בְּשֵׁמוֺת 1Chr 4:41 those recorded by name ; in prediction, עֲרִירִי הַזֶּה ׳כ אֶתהָֿאִישׁ Jer 22:30 register this man as childless ; with eschatological reference, לַחַיִּים כָּלהַֿכָּתוּב Isa 4:3 all those enrolled (i.e. appointed) unto life ; and, more explicitly, בַּסֵּפֶר כָּתוּב כָּלהַֿנִּמְצָא Dan 12:1 ; ׳י עַמִּים בִּכְתוֺבּ יִסְמֹּר Psa 87:6 ׳י shall reckon, when he registers (note absence of suffix) the peoples , etc. 4 = decree , מְרֹרוֺת עָלַי תִּכְתֹּב Job 13:26 thou ( ׳י ) decrest against me bitter things. Niph`al (chiefly late, especially Esther), Imperfect יִכָּתֵב Est 1:19 +, 3 feminine singular זֹאת תִּכָּ֫תֶב Psa 102:19 ; 3 masculine plural יִכָּתֵ֑בוּ Jer 17:13 3 t., יִכָּֽתְבוּן Job 19:23 ; Participle נִכְתָּב Est 3:12 2 t.; — 1 be written , subject words Job 19:23 , book Mal 3:16 ; be written בְּסֵפֶר Est 2:23 ; 9:23 , in, or among ב the laws 1:19 ; once, with יִכָּתֵ֑בוּ כֻּלָּם עַלסִֿפְרְךָ עַלֿ, Psa 139:16 in thy ׳י 's book all of them (my members) are written , i.e. written down, recorded (see below); absolute הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּשֵׁם נִכְתָּב אֲשֶׁר כְּתָב Est 8:8 a writing which is written in the king's name , compare (impersonal) 3:12 ; impersonal also צִוָּה כְּכָלאֲֿשֶׁר וַיִּכָּתֵב 3:12 ; 8:9 ; ׳יִכָּ followed by לְ = for Psa 102:19 ; followed by לְ + infinitive (really = a subject-cl., — the contents of the letter) Est 3:9 ; 8:5 . 2 be written down, recorded , Ezra 8:34 ; enrolled , יִכָּתֵ֑בוּ לֹא ישׂראל בית בִּכְתָב Ezek 13:9 in the enrolement of the house of Israel they are not enrolled (eschatolog.); אַליִֿכָּתֵ֑בוּ וְעִםצַֿדִּיקִים Psa 69:29 (|| מִסֵּפֶר יִמָּחוּ חַיִּים ) — יִכָּתֵ֑בוּ בָּאָרֶץ Jer 17:13 is difficult; Gie reads, plausibly, יִכָּרֵ֑תוּ מֵאֶרֶץ (compare Psa 34:17 ; 101:8 , etc.) Pi`el frequently, Perfect and Participle , only עָמָל כִּתֵּ֑בוּוּמְכַתְּבִים Isa 10:1 and busy writers that make a business of writing oppression (i.e. register unjust sentences, compare Qal 4 ; || חִקֲקֵיאָֿוֶן הַחֹקֲקִים ). כְּתַב verb write (see Biblical Hebrew); — Pe`al Perfect 3masculine singular ׳כ Dan 6:26 ל person + oratio recta [direct speech], 7:1 accusative of thing; 3 masculine plural כְּתַ֫בוּ Ezra 4:8 accusative אִגְּרָה ; 1 plural נִכְתּוּב 5:10 , accusative of thing; Participle active absolute feminine singular כָּֽתְבָה Dan 5:5 , subject יְדָא , feminine plural כָּֽתְבָן 5:5 , subject אֶצְבְּעָן . Pe`il (W CG 224 ) Perfect 3masculine singular תִּיב כְּ כִּדְנָה Ezra 5:7 thus (it) was written , so כ ׳כֵּן 6:2 .
